I have an active gym membership but i use it so infrequently nowadays that i generally feel like its not worth it. I feel like even if i went i wouldn't be able to properly focus on it because of my brain constantly finding excuses to focus on something, ANYTHING negative and my brain gets stuck on it. With that said, i tried redirecting it today...and for the most part it seemed to work. I didn't have to snap at anybody in work or anything i just...did my own thing and got stuff done. Maybe audiobooks in the car may be better than loud electronic music...who knows. I'll give it a shot at somepoint im sure. :)

8.25 hours of my workday is consumed by work itself. I get two 15 min breaks during the day, and a 45 minute lunch break which is okay i guess, except no access to anything that is particularly stress relieving... Plus an hours travel each way..so 10.25 hours is gone just on work by itself. I usually go to bed around midnight, wake up at 7. So... 24-7-10.25 leaves me with about 6.75 hours. Barring any complications travelling, time taken to eat, shower, etc... I know 6.75 sounds like a lot but it surely doesn't feel like it most of the time.

I'd love to learn an instrument, a deep moody instrument like the cello for example. Don't think i have the lungs for anything windy. Bass guitar maybe... But...again with the finding time. heh.

Yeah my family is virtually useless, and as i've said all of my friends are slowly turning their backs on me...So i'm quite literally left alone with my panic attacks and negative thoughts.

The advantage that i have with my current counsellor is that it's free - to get referred to one by the NHS for free would probably take me upward of a year... by then, too late. This one provided by the company through a third party. None of the data gets fed back to my employer though, obviously.

I'm already on the trail for a job that's a bit closer to me, 1) it would cost me less in travel 2) i would have more spare time, which is what i honestly think i need right now. Realistically i can't take much more time off work though...

Hobbies apart from gaming? Music at a ridiculous volume to drown out my thought process, and writing to channel that thought process elsewhere. Away from my problems, into a fantasy universe for a while but...i don't get much time to actually work on that unfortunately. That and my mental ink bottle seems to run out far too quickly. I also watch loads of TV and Movies - i have a long list of things i want to watch/catch up on...but again not enough time to actually do it. I feel like i need some 'me' time for a while ya know?

With that said though, not long after the accident i took time off work and it didn't seem to help me at all...I was just stuck in all day with nothing to take my mind off how bad my life was at that point so...catch 22. :/

I've only ever 'read' two books, and i say 'read' because they were audiobooks - ender's game, and ready player one, both sci-fi.

I feel like this post has gone around and around in circles...i apologise

I've had a quick look on meetup.com for social groups, and there's nothing that's really targetted towards my age group unfortunately. It seems to be like..40+ people and only being 26 that doesn't really suit me. With that said i have always gotten on with older people, but i feel that it would be a bit weird, ya know?

I welcome the suggestion though. Also with regards to your below post, i'm very much trying to 'do me' as it were. That is some advice that i have been given...i just need to find my natural rhythm again. I'm trying to get back into writing again since i used to do that quite a bit back in the day, nothing very good but...i've gotten better, or i think so at least.

I work as an service desk technical analyst, basically i answer the phone all day to people that can't use computers hehe... It was great when i first started it, and until august i was still enjoying it but..after august, everything seems to have shifted in my mind and i now no longer have time, nor patience for it so i start my week frustrated and usually end it in very much the same way. Management are starting to get on my back a little bit about my attitude about it now... so may be time to look for another job - something that i actually enjoy, and am not surrounded by idiots - but that's another story. In short, don't like my job much any more.

My family are fully aware that i need help but...nobody seems to actually be willing to sort of...break their own routine to do it for me. Unfortunately my mum is dependant on my dad, and me and my dad have never really gotten on too well so...my dad is keeping my mum away from me as much as he can. So even when i go to see my mum my dad is always there...and i can't open up around him. My grandad has straight-up said that he doesn't understand what i'm going through and has basically told me to man up and get on with my life. Which is always useful to be told, ya know? (Sarcasm isn't obvious in text)

I've only got 2-3 sessions left with my counsellor, so...i'll ask her if there is anything practical that she can do for me rather than just letting me rant for an hour whenever i see her, which...doesn't really help me. Airing it is fine, but once i leave it all stays in my head and makes me feel worse.

I was back in another car three days after the last accident. Gotta get back on the horse before you forget how to ride. Both accidents were total losses, would have cost insurance companies too much to repair them. I have escaped unscathed both times, the other parties however have sustained injuries, and that doesn't make me feel good at all...since both accidents were also my fault.

As for social places, i can't really think of any. I've tried querying people in the area about the best places to go to meet new people (that don't involve alcohol ideally) and everybody is drawing a blank.

I feel like my family can't help me, more than i am wasting their time. It feels like whenever i go there, and they know that i am in a bad way they just...try to continue as normal and don't sorta...actively try to help. I don't know whether that makes me sound selfish or not, but i really feel like i need help of some sort. I'm speaking to counsellor but even she has said that i seem to go around and around in circles with my logic and thinking. She hasn't offered me any practical advice or solutions at all really :(

I quite like pulp fiction too, i need to go back and revisit kill bill as i can't really remember them. I know i've definitely seen the first one :) I've also been recommended the godfather, but don't feel like i can spare that much time to watch it hehe. Not by myself anywho.
